payload.description:
## Intent

As a Kanbus CLI user (and as an agent dogfooding Kanbus), I want no-op updates, board-state commits, list --all, and discoverable dep help so that routine board operations succeed without extra git ceremony or confusing errors.

## In scope

1. Idempotent `kbs update` / `kanbus update` when requested fields already match (especially `--status` already at the target).
2. A `kbs commit` command that git-commits `project/issues` (not `kbs sync`; sync is Jira/Snyk/GitHub).
3. Remove stale issue files that `kbs show` reports as not found.
4. Discoverable `kbs dep --help` and usage errors with real examples; correct CLI_REFERENCE.md (it currently documents the nonexistent `kanbus dep add`).
5. `kbs list --all` as shorthand for `--limit 0`, Python and Rust parity.

## Out of scope

- Jira/Snyk/GitHub sync behavior
- Auto-push (commit only; agents still push)
- Changing `project/events/` gitignore
- Merging to main

## Definition of Done

- Gherkin scenarios exist for each behavior change and pass in Python (behave/pytest) and Rust (cargo test)
- Python and Rust produce identical observable CLI behavior
- PR opened against develop
payload.title: Fix CLI dogfood rough edges
